scenario_summary: Customer is locked out of their account due to forgotten credentials and is requesting a refund without an order number or account verification.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Haruto Tanaka and I'm 26. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.

Hello Haruto. I understand you're having trouble accessing your account. For security reasons, I cannot pull up an account using only a name. To assist you, I need to verify your identity. Could you please provide your full billing address and the last four digits of the credit card you used for the purchase?
Oh, I see. My billing address is 123 Maple Street, Springfield, and the card ends in 4492.

Thank you. I see an account matching those details. However, per our standard terms regarding account recovery, I am unable to process refunds or modify account details without full authentication through your registered email or phone number. Since you don't have access to those, I'll need to escalate this to our Account Security team.
That sounds like a lot of trouble. Can't you just check the order history under that card and process the refund? It was for a subscription I cancelled.

I apologize for the inconvenience, but I'm just following the protocol here. I don't have the specialized access required to bypass the primary email verification for refund requests. I am opening a ticket for the security team to contact you via an alternative method.
Okay, if that's what has to happen, please do it. How long will it take?
I've submitted the request to the Account Security team. You should receive an update within 24 to 48 hours. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

escalation_reason: Customer failed to provide sufficient verification credentials (email/phone access) to authorize a refund or account modification, requiring manual intervention by the Account Security team.
